 With 20 years of excellence in Allied Health, our client is one of Australia’s leading providers dedicated to empowering both their team and clients to reach their full potential and live life to the fullest. Operating 13 clinics across NSW and Tasmania, and supported by a team of over 200 professionals, they deliver exceptional multi-disciplinary care across 7 disciplines in a dynamic, supportive, and innovative environment. They foster a culture where excellence thrives through industry-leading career pathways, professional development, and collaboration.

 We’re seeking an enthusiastic and dedicated  Physiotherapist  to join our client's team in Cessnock. In this role, you will manage a varied caseload that includes treating musculoskeletal conditions and rehabilitating clients living with disabilities. Your responsibilities will include:

result.description:
Our client is an industry leading agribusiness with sophisticated Vegetable operations located in Bundaberg, QLD. They are currently looking to fill 100 Ground Vegetable Picker and Packer positions across their farming site, with work commencing from July 2026 onwards.  
You will be required to work in a farming environment where weather conditions typically include cool mornings and hot days from late September through October and into November, with temperatures increasing rapidly. Work is usually outdoors where you are required to perform repetitive tasks such as picking up pumpkins and melons or stacking boxes.
You will be paid under Agri Labour Australia Horticulture Agreement 2016 – Level 2, at a minimum hourly rate of $33.05 per hour, with at least 120 hours of work, every 4 weeks of your placement. This will be aligned with the Fair Work Commission's annual reviews, including any increases to the National Minimum Wage and minimum award rates of pay. You will be offered up to 9 months of work and potential to upskill into leadership roles.  
Key duties include:
•	Harvesting and packing melons, pumpkin and ground vegetables
•	Performing general farm labouring tasks as required
•	Working efficiently in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
•	Repetitive heavy lifting and stacking boxes
•	Outdoor work including hot, humid and wet weather.
Characteristics and Aptitudes:
To be considered for the roles, it's important you meet the following criteria:
•	Comfortable working in an outdoor environment
•	Good communication skills and able to follow instructions
•	No asthma or dust allergies
•	Live locally or be happy to relocate to Bundaberg
•	Comfortable working in various weather conditions
•	Able to follow directions and work unsupervised whilst showing high levels of initiative
•	A team player and happy working with a multicultural team
Choose Agri Labour Australia
Agri Labour Australia is an award-winning Australian company with clients in every State and Territory. Proudly representing major agribusiness, large primary producers, rural operators and local farmers - we are more than a recruitment agency. Founded on our firsthand knowledge of the land and dedicated to the ongoing success of our client's businesses and our candidate's careers, you can rely on us for expertise, advice and support.

result.description: Zenithra Holdings Pty Ltd   You Are Hired  is seeking a skilled and customer-focused  Electronic Equipment Trades Worker (ANZSCO 342313)  on behalf of our client,  A H R Mobile Pty Ltd .  About the Business:  A H R Mobile Pty Ltd operates a network of fast-paced retail outlets and kiosks located in shopping centres across Melbourne region. We specialize in on-the-spot mobile phone and tablet repairs, alongside selling a wide range of mobile accessories and protective gear.  About the Role:  In this dual-focused technical role, you will work directly from our retail outlets or kiosk stations, providing fast, reliable electronic repair services while assisting everyday shoppers. You will handle everything from basic component replacements to intricate logic board diagnostics and micro-soldering, while also upselling mobile accessories to store customers.  Work Structure: Full-time (38 hours per week).  Roster: Rotating roster aligned with shopping centre trading hours (including Thursday/Friday late-night trading and weekends).  Mobility: You must be flexible and willing to travel between various shopping centre locations in Melbourne region as scheduled.   Benefits   Competitive Salary: Market-aligned salary package + Superannuation (commensurate with trade experience).   Travel Allowance: Mileage/travel reimbursement provided when traveling between locations during work shifts.   Staff Discounts: Generous employee discounts on phone accessories, parts, and hardware.   Dynamic Work Environment: Engage directly with customers in vibrant, high-foot-traffic shopping centres.   Skills Development: Ongoing training in advanced micro-soldering and technical repair methods for the latest mobile device models.    Task & responsibilities   Device Diagnosis & Repair: Inspect, test, and troubleshoot faulty mobile phones, tablets, and wearable devices at the workbench using specialized diagnostic tools.   Component-Level Benchwork: Perform precise hardware repairs, including screen replacements, battery swaps, charging port repairs, speaker fixes, and micro-soldering on printed circuit boards (PCBs).   Accessory Sales & Customer Service: Greet customers, answer inquiries, and recommend/upsell mobile phone accessories (e.g., cases, screen protectors, chargers, and audio gear).   Quality Assurance: Test all repaired devices thoroughly before handing them back to the customer to ensure network and performance standards are met.   Workbench & Inventory Maintenance: Keep the workbench ESD-safe, clean, and organized, while managing stock levels for repair parts and retail accessories.   Multi-Site Coverage: Travel between designated shopping centre kiosks to cover shifts and manage repair volume during peak trading periods.    Qualification & experience   Qualifications:     AQF Certificate III in Electronics and Communications (UEE30920), Electrotechnology, or equivalent trade qualification; OR   At least 3 years of relevant hands-on trade experience in electronic equipment/mobile device repair (as per ANZSCO 342313 standards).     Technical Skills: Proven trade experience in mobile hardware diagnosis, precision hand-tool usage, micro-soldering, and PCB repair.   Customer & Sales Skills: Friendly, approachable attitude with experience in retail sales and customer service.   Flexibility & Mobility: Full availability for a rotating roster (including weekend retail hours) and a valid Driver’s License with reliable transport to move between shopping centre locations.   Communication: Excellent verbal and written English skills to interact with kiosk customers and document repair jobs clearly. Built on a foundation of integrity, speed, and personalised service, we partner with leading businesses across Australia to connect exceptional candidates with career-defining opportunities.  We are proud to partner with  AHR Mobile Pty Ltd —a rapidly expanding retail mobile repair and accessory business—to recruit skilled technical talent on their behalf. result.description: Tatura Hot Bread  The Retail Bakery & Operations Manager takes total operational responsibility for both the front-of-house (FOH) customer service spaces and the back-of-house (BOH) kitchen production environments for Tatura Hot Bread and Echuca Hot Bread.  This role bridges the gap between our production bakers, our short-order café chefs, and the counter service teams. The successful candidate will ensure premium food quality, seamless customer throughput during peak tourist/weekend rushes, tight wage control via optimized rostering, and proactive menu cost management.   Benefits   Attractive Remuneration:  A highly competitive base salary package ranging from  $78,000 – $85,000 per annum + 12% Superannuation  (negotiable based on your depth of multi-site experience).   Work-Life Balance Initiatives:  A structured 38-hour week with a rotating roster system, ensuring you get regular, predictable consecutive days off to recharge.   Career Growth & Autonomy:  Genuine operational freedom to implement your own systems, run creative menu specials, and make a measurable impact across two thriving businesses.   Daily Staff Perks:  Generous staff discounts and complimentary premium meals and coffee while on shift.   Task & responsibilities   Key Performance Areas & Responsibilities:    Front-of-House Operations & Team Leadership    Ensure both storefronts, pastry cabinets, bread displays, and dining areas are visually abundant, immaculately clean, and accurately priced from early morning opening onwards.  Design and implement weekly staff rosters that appropriately balance award penalty rates (weekends/public holidays) against customer foot traffic forecasts.  Handle high-volume trading periods hands-on, assisting on the floor where necessary to maintain elite standards of regional customer service.  Oversee point-of-sale (POS) systems, cash handling policies, register reconciliations, and verify weekly floor data for the internal accounting team.    Kitchen, Chef & Served Food Management    Provide leadership, structure, and scheduling for the kitchen teams/chefs at both the Tatura and Echuca venues.  Monitor standard operating procedures for the cooked-to-order breakfast and lunch programs, maintaining consistency in speed of service, presentation, and portion controls.  Audit kitchen cleaning schedules, temperature logs, cool room optimization, and strict food safety compliance across both properties.  Lead recruitment, onboarding, and training programs for new back-of-house kitchen personnel.    Menu Planning & Financial Performance    Partner directly with the business owners to maintain, refresh, and build appealing bakery-café menus, blackboard specials, and seasonal holiday packages.  Oversee food cost analysis (COGS), tracking ingredient pricing from suppliers and adapting recipes or retail menu pricing to protect gross profit margins.  Review daily waste sheets from both locations, matching production schedules with real-time retail demand data to minimize financial loss on fresh baked goods and fresh produce.    Qualification & experience   Required Skills & Experience:    Minimum 1 years of venue management experience within an fast-paced bakery, high-volume café, fast paced hospitality venue or retail supervisor role.  Proven track record managing workflows and supervising trade professionals   Strong capability in roster design, labor percentage analysis, and food wastage reduction.  Direct experience handling menu engineering, kitchen costing, and local supplier procurement is preferred  Thorough knowledge of OHS principles.   About Company    Tatura Bakery operates two highly successful, high-volume regional bakery and café operations.  Tatura Hot Bread and our expanded venue, Echuca Hot Bread. Known across the region for our famous artisan baking, award-winning vanilla slices, and comprehensive dine-in café menus, we serve thousands of loyal locals and visitors seven days a week.    We are recruiting directly for an experienced, energetic, and highly structured Retail Bakery & Operations Manager to oversee front-of-house service, lead our kitchen teams/chefs, manage hot food quality, and drive menu development across both locations. result.description:
Our client is an industry leading agribusiness with sophisticated Vegetable operations located in Bundaberg, QLD. They are currently looking to fill 100 Ground Vegetable Picker and Packer positions across their farming site, with work commencing from July 2026 onwards.  
You will be required to work in a farming environment where weather conditions typically include cool mornings and hot days from late September through October and into November, with temperatures increasing rapidly. Work is usually outdoors where you are required to perform repetitive tasks such as picking up pumpkins and melons or stacking boxes.
You will be paid under Agri Labour Australia Horticulture Agreement 2016 – Level 2, at a minimum hourly rate of $33.05 per hour, with at least 120 hours of work, every 4 weeks of your placement. This will be aligned with the Fair Work Commission's annual reviews, including any increases to the National Minimum Wage and minimum award rates of pay. You will be offered up to 9 months of work and potential to upskill into leadership roles.  
Key duties include:
•	Harvesting and packing melons, pumpkin and ground vegetables
•	Performing general farm labouring tasks as required
•	Working efficiently in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
•	Repetitive heavy lifting and stacking boxes
•	Outdoor work including hot, humid and wet weather.
Characteristics and Aptitudes:
To be considered for the roles, it's important you meet the following criteria:
•	Comfortable working in an outdoor environment
•	Good communication skills and able to follow instructions
•	No asthma or dust allergies
•	Live locally or be happy to relocate to Bundaberg
•	Comfortable working in various weather conditions
•	Able to follow directions and work unsupervised whilst showing high levels of initiative
•	A team player and happy working with a multicultural team
Choose Agri Labour Australia
Agri Labour Australia is an award-winning Australian company with clients in every State and Territory. Proudly representing major agribusiness, large primary producers, rural operators and local farmers - we are more than a recruitment agency. Founded on our firsthand knowledge of the land and dedicated to the ongoing success of our client's businesses and our candidate's careers, you can rely on us for expertise, advice and support.
If you believe you're a great fit for the role, click on the below link to apply now.
https://www.agrilabour.com.au/candidates/current-positions/ground-vegetable-picker-and-packer-bundaberg-qld-bbbh29421/.
